# netactuate_oidc_client_bare_metal_servers (Data Source)

Reads OIDC Client Bare Metal Servers visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_oidc_client_bare_metal_servers" "example" {
  oidc_client_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `oidc_client_id` (Number) OIDC client ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `servers` (List of Object) Bare metal servers allowed to access the OIDC client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `mbpkgid` (Number)
- `raw_json` (String)
